p.descriptionHtml:
A chain that closes with a turn rather than a catch. This necklace runs 50cm in a 4mm width, finished with a gold toggle clasp that sits at the front or the side as you prefer: a ring of about 22mm across and a bar of about 15mm. The PVD coating is bonded to the steel, so the gold tone holds through daily wear. Wear it over a knit in winter, or alone on a warm evening.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the toggle turned to the front so the clasp becomes part of it.

Details

  • Length: 50cm
  • Width: 4mm
  • Weight: 12g
  • Closure: Gold toggle clasp, the ring approximately 22mm across and the bar approximately 15mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18k gold tone coating
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
